signature: A round lake of boiling, burning tar in grey fog: patchy charcoal-sand islands, old boardwalks on concrete feet 2-6 m above it (some burnt to stumps, one sunk onto a drowned lighthouse), roofs, poles and pylons going under, bone-white leviathans breaching like dolphins, and four one-of-a-kind ways out.

exits.label: Opened the odd barn door standing on its stone plinth and went through
exits.source_quote: Finding an odd barn door on a stone plinth and going through it.
exits.hint: Across the sand spit from where you land, something red stands on a block of stone.

exits.label: Climbed into the drowned lighthouse's gallery and tampered with the flickering beacon
exits.method: Submerged lighthouse gallery; tamper with beacon
exits.source_quote: then tampering with the functional, flickering beacon within it.
exits.hint: A light flickers far to the west, low over the tar. A walkway leads that way.

exits.label: Clambered in through the broken window of the sunken navy vessel's bridge
exits.method: Broken window of submerged navy vessel bridge
exits.source_quote: Clambering inside the broken window of a submerged bridge for a USA navy vessel.
exits.hint: The highest walkway climbs north from the midway island towards something grey and square.

exits.label: Got into the booster nozzle of the upside-down shuttle
exits.method: Booster nozzles of upside-down NASA shuttle
exits.source_quote: Somehow getting oneself into the booster nozzles of an upside down, NASA space shuttle.
exits.hint: East, past the plinth, a walkway leads to an island with two white cylinders lying against its shore.

fail_states.label: Held in the tar for more than a second
fail_states.source_quote: especially for any time over a second

fail_states.label: Taken under by a Collagen Leviathan at an island edge or on a walkway
fail_states.source_quote: grab the wanderer(s) within their jaws and subsequently burrow back within the tar

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Collagen Leviathans (CONFIRMED) as a scripted presence: passive dolphin dives and a telegraphed strike at island edges and walkways, never combat. The Macchina and the Lost (link list only) are absent.
content_warning: Page: burns, melting flesh, fusing with tar, abduction deaths, intoxication, dehydration. Implied only: captions, red tint, blackout.
notes: SOURCE: bubbling, oozing, flaming asphalt tar pit with charcoal desert, perpetual grey fog; tar never cools, boils at ~95 C; heat and fumes intoxicate (fainting, illness, vomiting); touch burns even through clothing, flesh fuses past about a second; shallow tar with patchy hot charcoal-sand islands in clusters (bones, dead dried bushes only; do not stand still); islands and piers are the two safe ways; piers: concrete or metal supports, wooden legs and walkways, 2-6 m up, not connected to islands; dry boardwalks burn to their concrete supports; ground gives way, platforms sink and burn; rare fires spread over the tar; submerged telegraph poles, small pylons, tiled bungalow roofs, flat brick townhouse roofs, metal rods; circular lake, ~15 m dunes nobody gets within 50 m of; ~10 failed groups in 50 years (one harvested telegraph copper), their remains blend with the boardwalks; no bases now; Collagen Leviathans (fossil-bone eels 7-20 ft) breach like dolphins, shower tar, sense wanderers at island edges or on piers, leap, grab and burrow; exits: navy vessel bridge broken window (L500), shuttle booster nozzles (L515), barn door on a stone plinth (L612), lighthouse gallery beacon (L626), each unique. ADAPTATION: lake ~500 m across with dunes at r 252-290 m (page gives no size); fog and height fog hide the dunes; the authored network (arrival island, sand spit, plinth island, midway island, shuttle island; three boardwalks at 2.4-4.6 m) plus seeded outlying islets, ruins, sunken decks, roofs, poles, rods and fires; group-built ladders are the way up to the walkways (page: groups built bridges to islands); the lighthouse gallery is reached down a boardwalk that sank onto it; the navy bridge's forward deckhouse roof sits level with the end of the highest walkway; the fume meter only rises (fainting resets it to 62% and costs health); the leviathan wakes at random, senses you at an island edge or on a walkway, bulges the tar beside you after ~6 s, then strikes where you stood (sprint away; burning tar spray if close). Exits L041>L500#1 and L041>L515#2 are documented edges (transitions.json) added in the v2 rebuild. Exits exist only within ~60 m of their object. QA: no damage or death in QA mode; the walker bot walks the sand spit to the barn door (about 25 m).
